messages:
dan: hi folks, dan here (new hire). first task: run infra pipeline from my fork. buildkite job fails pulling the runner image with a 403. any onboarding gotchas?

rachel: welcome! :wave: usually GHCR auth or pipeline membership. can you paste the agent error?

dan: paste from agent:
```
failed to pull image \"ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:latest\": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve reference: access denied: 403
{"message":"You must have read access to the container registry."}
```

tom: forks don't get the org GitHub App token and Actions don't expose secrets to fork PRs. also make sure you're in the redwood-ci okta group for pipeline perms. iris can help add you.

iris: adding Dan to redwood-ci now. also check your email for the GitHub App install invite (sometimes it lands after org invite).

ops-bot: Access request created: CI-11337 owner=iris status=pending reviewers=[infra-oncall].

dan: i accepted the org invite but no app invite showed up. restarted build after iris added me to okta but still 403.

rachel: if the app isn't installed on your fork, GHCR pulls will fail. We usually either: 1) ask maintainers to run the CI in upstream, or 2) hand out a short-lived scoped PAT (packages:read) and add it as a masked CI_GHCR_TOKEN. Which do you want?

dan: short-lived PAT works for now. less friction while I'm iterating.

iris: created a 6h token scoped to packages:read and set masked pipeline var CI_GHCR_TOKEN. restart when ready.

dan: restarted build  build pulled image successfully and tests started. thanks! :tada:

tom: nice. follow-up items: rachel, can we add a "forks + GHCR" note to the onboarding checklist? also consider a fallback public mirror for runner image to reduce manual tokens.

rachel: yes adding a short note and filing an RFC for fallback mirror. also adding a checklist step: "accept GitHub App install" and "verify redwood-ci Okta membership".

dan: appreciate the warm welcome and quick help. i'll send a tiny PR to the onboarding docs with what I hit.

iris: welcome aboard! ping us if anything else blocks you.
